name: money-manager
description: Personal Finance and Monthly Salary Allocation Web Application

scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run start:backend" "wait-on http://localhost:3001 && npm run start:frontend"
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && echo 'Setup complete! Run npm run dev to start both servers.'
